### What change is being made

Please provide a detailed description of WHAT change is being made such that the reader is able to
understand the change holistically.

### Why this change is being made

Please provide the rationale behind the change and additional context like links to documents,
related work or issues.

### Tested

Please provide a description how this change was tested, e.g. the commands you ran, whether the
package still builds (`colcon build`), and whether the reproduction demo in `docs/GRANDTOUR.md`
still runs.

### Checklist

- [ ] No model weights, datasets, rosbags or other large binaries are committed
- [ ] No credentials, internal hostnames, IP addresses or personal paths are included
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes
- [ ] New or changed dependencies are pinned in `docker/requirements/`
- [ ] Code copied from another project is listed in `NOTICE`, with its licence text in `licenses/`
